title: Chapter 448 The Tang Empire Is Destroyed
content:
Chapter 448 The Tang Empire Is Destroyed

The lives of the common people are like ants, no one cares about them at all, so the battle in mid-air is still going on slowly, and the aftermath caused by the battle is getting bigger and bigger, gradually turning the entire Chang'an city into ruins.

When the last commoner in Chang'an City died, the battle almost came to an end.

After all, Yuan Tiangang was seriously injured, and it was difficult for him to display three or four layers of strength. Under the siege of three masters of the same level, he didn't last long before falling away.

Next is the new emperor of the Tang Empire, the Celestial Immortal Emperor. Although this emperor has amazing luck and constant adventures, he also has extraordinary aptitude and extraordinary comprehension. He has made rapid progress in cultivation. He has stepped into the realm of Celestial Immortals in just over 30 years. Countless others.

But no matter how bad luck his aptitude is, the emperor's background is a little shallow after all. He has only been a fairy for a hundred years. For those veterans who have been a fairy for thousands of years, even if their cultivation base is deeper, they still have insufficient experience. .

Under the siege of four strong men of the same level, even if the emperor was able to 1v3 within the same level, he still couldn't hold back and fell into a disadvantage.

In the end, after fighting thousands of moves, the newly-promoted Celestial Emperor finally couldn't hold on, and with the last temporary counter-kill, he brought the two Celestials with him.

Up to now, only the old emperor who founded the country is left on the battlefield of the Tang Empire.

The old emperor had profound cultivation and rich experience. He had gone through countless life and death fights in his life, and only then did he create the foundation of the Tang Dynasty. Naturally, he did not fall so easily.

However, as his two helpers died one after another, whether the old emperor fell into deep pain psychologically or fell into a disadvantaged form, the fate of this war was doomed.

At this time, the old emperor had only one person, while the opposite angel had ten giants, with a gap of 1:10. Even though many people on the opposite side were injured in the battle just now, they could still display their strength easily. to kill the old emperor.

After falling into desperation completely, the old emperor also understood his destiny, there was no escape, no retreat. His most valued descendant has fallen, and the Tang Empire is now dilapidated, and it is meaningless to live any longer.

So the old emperor chose the cruelest endgame and died with his opponent.

Under the old emperor's reckless style of play, Tianxian, who had already taken advantage of the opposite side, was naturally unwilling to bear it, and entangled one after another, intending to drag the old emperor to death slowly.

But it's a pity that on the battlefield, you can escape wherever you want. With the old emperor's desperate efforts, at the moment of his fall, three heavenly immortals followed in his footsteps and turned into ashes together.

This time, the six surrounding countries jointly crusade against the Tang Empire came to an end, and finally ended with the demise of the Tang Empire.

Although the war was over, the waves caused by the war were far from calming down, and instead became more and more turbulent.

During this period of time, for some reason, there were existences at the level of celestial beings one after another, life-and-death struggles occurred, and they fell one after another, as if they didn't want money.

In such a short period of time, more than ten immortals were killed or injured in a mere place in the south. The huge number is terrifying, and it only happened in ancient times when the human race was determined.

This is an obvious and ridiculous difference from the death and injury of a sixth- and seventh-level master before, which shocked the whole country and spread the news around the world.

During the period of turmoil in the Tang Empire, in fact, this kind of war at the level of celestial beings also took place in the other four empires, and the scale was also not small. The fall of celestial beings is even more common, which thoroughly shows that the world of great struggle is the most important. The intense moment is coming.

After the demise of the Tang Empire, the southern countries fought openly and secretly around the legacy of the Tang Empire. In addition, the destruction of the royal families of the Han and Wei countries also vacated the territory of the two empires. In addition, the Tang Empire has a total of seven The cakes of the eight empires are waiting to be cut by neighboring countries.

This is a coveted piece of fat, everyone wants to take a bite, and there is the biggest one.

However, those covetous people around them all clearly expressed the thoughts in their hearts, and it was difficult to realize them at all.

So after a lot of wrangling and bargaining, some reached an agreement, while others argued endlessly. In the end, it was even more of a fight, life and death.

In less than three months after the battle of the Tang Empire's demise, three more battles at the level of celestial beings broke out in the southern region, and in each of them, celestial beings fell.

When their respective disputes are almost over, and the south also has a cake that they are satisfied with due to the large-scale reduction of benefit distributors, and they are ready to stop.

There were originally nine kingdoms in the south. After this annexation, all the royal families fell and their power was wiped out.

In the end, only the Three Kingdoms were left with blood inheritance, and they completely became the biggest beneficiaries of this struggle.

And because of this series of fights, there were originally 21 heavenly immortals in the south, but only five were left, and their strength was greatly damaged. It is no longer possible to deter the surrounding monster races like before. The surrounding monster races are ready to move, and there is a faint tendency to rise, and the great cause of the human race is in jeopardy.

The southern area of the human race is connected to a piece of low hills. The area of the hills is huge, the size of three empires, and the miasma and poisonous smoke are everywhere, and the poisonous insects and beasts are rampant. In addition, the monsters cultivated into spirits often disappear. Stretch the tentacles into it.

After tens of thousands of years of recuperation, the monster race in the southern hills has accumulated a considerable amount of power.

There are seven fairy-level monsters alone, which is not enough to mention the previous southern human forces. But now the southern human race is killing each other among themselves, and the top combat power is even less than that of the monsters under the great loss of strength. The situation has reversed.

As for the other monsters of the sixth and seventh ranks, there are more than a hundred of them, and together with the number of demon soldiers reaching tens of millions, their strength is enough to start a war of extermination in the entire south.

However, the human race has just experienced continuous battles, their foundations are exhausted, and their strength is not as strong as the eleventh before the war, so they can't resist at all.

It is under such circumstances that the remaining Three Kingdoms are secretly licking their wounds, and guarding against the prying eyes of the monster race, and there are conflicts among them. It can be said that the south has completely lost control.

As for Zhong Yu, he made a bold move at this moment.

When the southern countries were in war, after half a year of preparations, Yuguo already had an army of 5 million, commanded by dozens of powerhouses of rank six or seven.

Under Zhong Yu's personal oath, millions of troops crossed the border between Han Wei and Yu Kingdom, and started a large-scale strategy.

Not long after the southern region was pacified, another large-scale war broke out, but the leaders of this war were all mortals below the eighth level.
